label: GitHub Pull Request
description: A pull request in a repository the GitHub connector syncs: a read-only task whose title, body and status come from GitHub. Status is pending while open, completed when merged, and canceled when closed without merging.

github_id.description: The pull request's GitHub node id.

number.description: The pull request's number in its repository.

repository.description: The repository's full name, as owner/name.

private.description: Whether the repository this row is in is private on GitHub, as of the last read.

author.description: The GitHub login that opened the pull request.

pr_state.description: The pull request's state on GitHub: open, merged, or closed without merging.

draft.description: Whether the pull request is a draft on GitHub.

merged_at.description: When the pull request was merged, if it was.

base_branch.description: The branch the pull request targets.

head_branch.description: The branch the pull request comes from.

checks.description: A summary of the checks on the pull request's head commit: the rollup state, non-zero check run counts by state (check_runs), and non-zero commit status counts by state (statuses). Null when the commit has no checks.

github_updated_at.description: When GitHub last changed the pull request.
